unknown_and_unverified_process_bindings: Summaries are generation/island aggregates (not births or complete genomes).

Runs lacking proc_config.json (xbabe1 c01/c02, xbabe2 c01, xbabe3 c01/c02, xbabe4 c01/c02) have expected_islands=None in native_history::coverage(None); observing islands 0..3 does not prove four were configured.
proc_config.json added_utc and STOPPED_MEMORY timestamps are configuration-addition / executor-relief receipts, not verified OS process start/termination receipts.
Current on-disk binary hashes on xbabe1..4 do not retrospectively prove which binary image each historical process executed.
